blurb: Majorelle Spa provides one-of-a-kind spa treatments inspired by Moroccan design and rituals, focusing on restoring the body and resetting the mind. Treatments include consultation, aroma selection, tension release, circulation boost, and skin renewal with private steam and unhurried transitions. The spa is open daily from 10AM to 6PM and offers memberships with additional benefits.
